verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes a comprehensive public REST API with documented endpoints (e.g., create_campaign, create_event), authentication schemes (private key, OAuth, public key), scopes, rate-limit headers, SDKs for multiple languages, a sandbox test environment, and Postman collections—everything needed for an AI-native user to programmatically drive the product. Missing for 10: no llms.txt discovery file (404 probe) which would aid automated/agentic discovery of the API docs.
